flows.description: Infection of susceptible individuals through contact with infectious individuals in compartment I1. The total force of infection is proportional to the sum of I1 and I2.
Infection of susceptible individuals through contact with infectious individuals in compartment I2. The total force of infection is proportional to the sum of I1 and I2.
Progression from the first exposed sub-compartment to the second.
Progression from the second exposed sub-compartment to become infectious.
Progression from the first infectious sub-compartment to the second.
Progression from the second infectious sub-compartment to the removed/recovered state.

parameters.description: Transmission rate parameter, representing the rate at which new infections take place given a contact. Inferred in the paper via re-parametrization, so no fixed value is provided.
Daily rate of transition through each of the two exposed (E) sub-compartments. The total average incubation period is 2/σ. Value is from Table 1.
Daily rate of transition through each of the two infectious (I) sub-compartments. This represents progression towards recovery. The total average infectious period is 2/γ. Value is from Table 1.
Total population size. The paper provides values for three seasons; this value is for the 2012/13 season from Table 1.
